# Location scope: a building the food rule builds has a level under construction here (the rule waits for it).
pp_cplan_food_queued = {
	any_buildings_in_location = {
		building_levels_under_construction > 0
		OR = {
			building_type = building_type:wheat_farm
			building_type = building_type:wheat_farmstead
			building_type = building_type:wheat_rotations

# Any scope: the market limit holds for the constructions of the rule group with this code (the Businesses
# group, profile rules and marks; the food rule builds for hunger, the others no business types of their own).
pp_cplan_limits_market_105 = {
	always = yes
}
pp_cplan_limits_market_101 = {
	always = no
}
pp_cplan_limits_market_102 = {
	always = no
}

	always = no
}

	always = yes
}
pp_cplan_limits_market_107 = {
	always = no
}
